Never again - The apartment was clean, spacy and nicely equipped While the apartment itself was generally acceptable, there were several important issues that significantly affected our experience. First, the property has two floors of very steep stairs and no elevator access. Additionally, the shower drain was partially clogged and the bathroom was not particularly clean upon arrival. The apartment was also poorly stocked for a group booking — only 4 coffee capsules were provided despite our reservation being for 7 guests. The location was also disappointing, with no parking available nearby and limited convenient public transportation access. However, the main reason for this complaint is the complete lack of support after 10:30 PM. After accidentally locking ourselves out, we contacted the apartment support team. They informed us that they would leave a replacement key in a locker box and provide us with a new access code. We agreed to this solution. However, when we returned at approximately 11:10 PM, the code they provided did not work. As a result, we were left outside in the cold for nearly 3 hours with 4 small children, desperately trying to find someone who could help us. The apartment support team stopped answering the phone entirely and did not respond until the next morning around 9:30 AM. We also contacted Booking.com support during the night, but we were told that nothing could be done because they themselves were unable to reach the property management. Ultimately, we had no choice but to book a hotel for the night. Despite the situation being clearly caused by the property’s mistake — specifically providing us with an incorrect access code and then becoming unreachable — the apartment management refused to reimburse us for the hotel expenses. Their explanation that “the problem was ours because we locked ourselves out” is completely unreasonable, especially considering they had already agreed to provide an alternative solution and then failed to do so correctly.

Evitatelo se non volete brutte sorprese! - Il wifi funziona. Sconsiglio il soggiorno in questa struttura per una serie di mancanze riguardanti il servizio, la manutenzione e, non ultimo, l’inadeguatezza della gestione. Il miscelatore della doccia si è rotto al primo utilizzo a causa di evidenti segni di ruggine. Può succedere, non è colpa di nessuno, ma come è stata gestita la situazione è imbarazzante. Siamo stati 3 giorni su 4 senza poter utilizzare la doccia. Un tecnico è entrato ripetutamente nell'appartamento in nostra assenza, violando la nostra privacy senza che la struttura ci offrisse alcuna soluzione sicura per i nostri effetti personali, se non suggerendoci di pagare a nostre spese un locker esterno. Nonostante i continui passaggi del tecnico, l'appartamento non è mai stato pulito e abbiamo trovato il bagno sporco e con impronte di scarpe sul pavimento al nostro rientro, senza che la proprietà provvedesse al ripristino del decoro. Non siamo stati spostati di camera. L’aspetto più grave riguarda il tentativo di addebitarci 250€ per il danno al miscelatore, nonostante non ci fosse stato detto nulla durante il soggiorno e nonostante la rottura fosse dovuta alla palese vetustà dell'impianto (tutto ripreso da video e foto che ho fornito a Booking). Fortunatamente, grazie all'intervento di Booking, la contestazione è stata chiusa a nostro favore, riconoscendoci anche un indennizzo per la mancanza di servizi essenziali. Oltre a questo: il divano letto è scomodo e rumoroso e la struttura dello stesso è sporca (il cuscino arancione che vedete in foto non viene lavato da un bel po', vista la patina che ha, così come il divano). Palazzo rumoroso, ogni sera si sentivano rumori di stoviglie come se ci fosse la cucina di un ristorante vicino. Isolamento acustico inesistente. Bollitore con resistenza a contatto con l'acqua, sconsiglio l'utilizzo e al nostro arrivo conteneva ancora l'acqua di quelli prima di noi. Non è vera l'indicazione daily cleaning&concierge.

Goede locatie, maar te duur betaald wat je er voor krijgt - De locatie was goed. Het was nog geen 5 minuten lopen van de Champs-Elysees. Ook is het gelegen met genoeg eettentjes, restaurants en supermarkten in de buurt We stayed in this apartment in Paris for a week, but unfortunately we felt the value for money was very disappointing for around €200 per night. The biggest issue was the lack of privacy. A neighbor regularly looked into the apartment through the window, and people from the apartments above could also easily look inside from the rooftop area. There is no proper way to block this view. Especially near the stairs leading to the sleeping area, this felt very uncomfortable. In addition, the kitchen blind was almost falling off and did very little to prevent people from looking inside. As soon as the sun rises, the apartment also becomes very bright, making it difficult to sleep in. The bathroom was another disappointment. There was quite a lot of mold, and especially above eye level there was a noticeable amount of dust, giving the impression that the apartment was not cleaned properly. The apartment also smelled damp and musty. Ventilation is poor because there is only one small window that can be opened, unless you also leave the front door open. The apartment is located close to a metro line. During the day you can hear and even feel the metro passing by every five minutes or so. Fortunately, this was less of an issue at night. We also struggled with the front door lock. It was difficult to lock the door properly and often hard to remove the key from the lock. Overall, we feel we paid far too much for what was offered and were genuinely disappointed considering the price. We would absolutely not recommend this apartment. We would rather stay a bit further away from the city center and travel a little more in exchange for a comfortable, clean, and private apartment with a much better value for money.

ביקורת - המיקום נחמד מאוד, קרוב לאייפל. בסביבה יש חנויות , מסעדות וברים. קיים wifi בדירה. דירה מרווחת, יש סלון, 2 חדרי שינה, פינת אוכל, מקרר, שמקרר סביר, מכונת כביסה. הגענו בשבוע הכי חם שנראה בפריז, לאחר בקשה קיבלנו 2 מאווררים קטנים מאוד שלא עזרו בכלום. החום היה פשוט סיוט ולא נסבל בעליל בדירה. סבלנו ממש. ביקשנו לקצר את השהות ונעננו בשלילה, חוויה זו הייתה ממש מאכזבת עבורנו ברמה שלא הצלחנו להישאר שם ולא לישון בלילה בגלל החום. לבסוף קנינו מזגן נייד כי לא הייתה ברירה מאחר ולא רצו להחזיר לנו את הכסף והילדים כמעט התייבשו מחום. פנינו לבוקינג בבקשה לעזרה ובעלי הידרה התעלמו מהטלפונים והמיילים ששלחו להם. המעלית לרוב הייתה תקועה ולא היה ניתן להשתמש בה, נאלצנו לעלות ולרדת ברגל 3 קומות גם ביציאה הורדנו מלא מזוודות ברגל כי המעלית לא עבדה. ניקיון סביר ולא מעבר. המקרר לא קירר טוב, ככל הנראה היה קפוא, התלוננו על כך אמרו שיבואו לתקן ביום למחר ולא באו. לא הייתה תאורה בחדרים למעט מנורת צד. כן אציין לשבח שביקשנו לאחר את הצ'ק אאוט ולבסוף אישרו לנו יציאה בשעה 14:00 במקום ב11:00.

Estancia bien ubicada, pero con graves problemas de ruido, seguridad y descanso. - La ubicación del apartamento es muy buena. Hay acceso cercano a varios medios de transporte y también muchos restaurantes cerca, lo cual fue conveniente durante la estancia. El baño es bueno y el apartamento cuenta con cocina, lo cual también fue positivo. Sin embargo, estos aspectos positivos no compensan los problemas serios que tuvimos durante la última semana de nuestra estancia. Durante varias noches hubo ruidos muy fuertes entre las 11:00 p.m. y las 4:00 a.m. Personas se reunían en el pasillo cerca de nuestra puerta, hablaban en voz alta, entraban y salían constantemente, y la puerta principal hacía mucho ruido. También hubo situaciones preocupantes de seguridad: personas desconocidas golpearon puertas, gritaron y causaron disturbios de madrugada, incluso golpeando nuestra puerta y la entrada principal del edificio. Esto afectó gravemente nuestro descanso y dañó la última parte de nuestras vacaciones. Reportamos los problemas varias veces al manager por Booking.com y WhatsApp, pero la respuesta no siempre fue rápida ni adecuada. En una ocasión preguntamos si debíamos llamar a la policía y primero se nos dijo que no; luego Booking.com nos recomendó hacerlo por preocupación de seguridad. Aunque el edificio tenía reglas de silencio después de las 9:00 p.m. y nosotros las cumplimos, no hubo suficiente control de otros huéspedes o personas en el edificio. Además, el manager parecía no saber que la limpieza estaba incluida en nuestra reserva. Después de varios días tuve que exigir que limpiaran el apartamento porque estaba en el contrato. El sofá cama también se volvió muy incómodo después de unos cinco días, especialmente para una estancia larga. No recomendaría este apartamento para estancias largas ni para quienes necesiten descansar bien o sentirse seguros.

Despite the excessive heat, the beds were provided with heavy winter comforters, which made sleeping even more difficult. Basic necessities were also missing. There was no hand soap, no dishwasher detergent, and no laundry detergent—not even enough for the first one or two loads of laundry. The couch in the living room may be suitable for children, but it is neither appropriate nor comfortable for adults to sleep on. Considering the price we paid, we expected the property to be clean, properly maintained, comfortable, and fully functional. At the very least, the television, fans, and basic household amenities should have been available and working. This property urgently needs attentive and responsible management that genuinely cares about its condition and the comfort, health, and safety of its guests.

Communication was excellent throughout our stay, and they provided clear, detailed instructions that made check-in and check-out easy. Although fans are provided, there is no air conditioning, which we expected, but the bedroom has no windows and this makes airflow very limited. During our stay, temperatures were around 30°C, and on our first night there was a celebration at the bar downstairs after France won a soccer match that lasted until around 3–4 a.m. Because of the noise, keeping the windows open wasn't a practical option. Overall, a pleasant stay, but we wouldn’t stay here again. - The apartment is located in a quiet suburb of Paris, in a peaceful neighborhood with very little noise. It is very convenient for transportation, with both the Vincennes RER A station and the Bérault Metro (Line 1) just a 5–7 minute walk away. It’s an excellent location if you are planning to visit Disneyland Paris. Both the main bed and the sofa bed were comfortable and provided a good night’s sleep. We also appreciated the thoughtful amenities, including coffee, toothpaste, and toothbrushes. The host was very responsive, provided detailed instructions on how to get to the apartment, and replied promptly to all of our messages, which we greatly appreciated. However, it would be helpful if the host could communicate in English when guests ask questions in English, as this would make communication much easier for international travelers. We visited Paris during an extreme heat wave, with temperatures reaching 37–40°C. The first thing that surprised us was that the apartment is located on the ground floor, which was not mentioned in the listing. When you open the front door, you step directly onto the street. There are two entrance doors (a metal security door and the main door), but the main door does not close properly from the outside. The apartment itself is nicely renovated, but there was an unpleasant odor every time we entered, probably because the building is quite old. Fortunately, it became much less noticeable after opening the windows for a while. The biggest disappointment was that there was no refrigerator, even though one is listed among the amenities. During such hot weather, we had no way to keep drinking water or food cold, which was a major inconvenience. Another drawback, especially in the summer, is the lack of air conditioning. I realize this was my oversight, as I forgot to check this before booking, but future guests visiting during hot weather should be aware of it. The shower area is not properly sealed, so water easily flows onto the bathroom floor. It would also be helpful to install a small shelf in the shower for shampoo and other toiletries. In addition, providing more toilet paper for longer stays would improve the guest experience. Overall, the apartment is in a convenient location with excellent public transport connections. However, addressing these issues would make the stay significantly more comfortable.

Cependant, quelques points négatifs : - la propreté : des traces de saleté sur les serviettes, des auréoles sur le canapé, un paquet de cigarette présent sur le canapé à notre arrivée, des odeurs d’égout dans la salle de bain - la salle de bain est TRÈS petite, on a pas la place de s’y sécher, et l’eau du lavabo de s’évacue pas - pour dormir: les rideaux ne sont pas occultants, donc grand jour dès 5h du matin, il y fait très vite chaud donc on ouvre les fenêtres mais il y a alors un vacarme incessant dans la rue, donc impossible de dormir En conclusion, on a passé un super séjour dans cet appart mais quelques points négatifs

- The location is fantastic, and the sheets and towels were lovely and clean. The apartment clearly has real character and was once a lovely space, though it would benefit from a little upkeep in a few areas. A few things for future guests to be aware of. The layout is a little unusual - you need to pass through one bedroom to reach the other, and the internal doors between the bedrooms and living room don’t quite close properly. The front door lock had been painted over, so it was a bit tricky to use. As with many old Parisian apartments, the floors creak and a fair amount of street noise comes through. The washing machine isn’t fixed in place, so it moves around and needs nudging back when in use. Bolting it to the wall would make a real difference. It would also help to have somewhere to hang washed clothes. All in all, a characterful apartment in a wonderful location that would shine with a bit of attention to the details.

- This was an amazing stay for me and my seven friends! There was plenty of room for all of us to live comfortably and it is in the best area too! Very lively and walkable. It was everything we hoped for! We wish we had come on a bit of a cooler weekend, but they had as many accommodations as they could so we thank them for that! They also let us check in early which was very gracious. Perfect for a quick weekend getaway to Paris, thank you to the friendly and kind hosts!

Amazing location - Amazing location and plenty of space in rooms. Wonderful to have full kitchen and laundry. Eine Klimaanlage gab es leider nicht, dafür aber 2 Ventilatoren, sodass unser Aufenthalt auch bei Temperaturen von bis zu 38 Grad Celsius aushaltbar war. Die Unterkunft war sehr schön und für einen Städtetrip voll zu empfehlen, vor allem wegen der zentralen Lage

- The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and fully equipped with everything we needed for our stay. The air conditioning was a major advantage, especially during the hot summer days in Paris, and we really appreciated having it. However, there were a few important issues that future guests should be aware of. The biggest drawback is the location. The apartment is directly next to a bar, and from early morning until around 11:00 p.m., when the bar closes, groups of people stand outside drinking and talking immediately in front of the entrance. This creates constant noise and makes entering and leaving the property less comfortable than expected. I also believe the apartment is suitable for a maximum of three adults, not four as advertised. The sofa bed is worn and needs repair or replacement. It is not comfortable enough for two adults and is only suitable for two young children. However, considering the bar next door and the atmosphere around the entrance throughout the day and evening, I would not consider this property ideal for families with small children. Finally, the TV was not connected to an antenna, so it did not work during our stay. Overall, the apartment itself is clean, comfortable, and well equipped, but the location and the sleeping arrangements significantly affected our experience.

最悪 - なし 今回の滞在はかなり残念でした。エレベーターがなく、重いスーツケースを持って3階まで非常に狭い階段で上がる必要があり、とても大変でした。多くの荷物がある方、お年寄りの方にはオススメ出来ません。特にパリが35℃近い暑さだったにもかかわらず、部屋にはクーラーがなく扇風機だけで、本当にかなり厳しかったです。夜も暑く、快適に過ごせませんでした。実際に熱中症になりかけるほどの環境で、体調的にもかなりきつい滞在でした。途中で別のホテルに変更しました。 また、タオル交換もなく、宿泊料金に対してサービス内容が全く見合っていないと感じました。ここはホテルではなく、エアビーだから交換とかはないわ、とかなり強気な口調だったのも残念です。これまでさまざまな宿泊施設を利用してきましたが、このような環境の宿泊先は初めてで正直とてもショックを受けました。 さらに、これらの点について問い合わせや相談をしましたが、返信もなく非常に不信感を抱きました。問題が起きること自体は仕方ないと思いますが、その後の対応が全くなかったことが一番残念です。サービス面も含めて、価格に見合う宿泊施設とは思えませんでした。再利用はしないです。

UNA PESADILLA - NADA Este apartamento, si puede llamarse así, es un timo, tanto por las instalaciones pero sobre todo por el ambiente de inseguridad que hay en esa calle por las noches. No hay luz natural ni ventilación, lo que parece una ventana en realidad da a un agujero que puede describirse como un ‘zulo’ pequeño, oscuro, cerrado y lleno de porquería. Respecto al baño, una cosa es que sea pequeño y otra muy distinta es que al sentarte en el inodoro prácticamente estés metido en la ducha, y que por la colocación del espejo no haya espacio para lavarte los dientes y la cara sin mojar todo el baño. Dentro de la habitación no hay cobertura para llamar ni tampoco llegan los datos, la única forma de comunicarte con el exterior es conectándose a su wifi que no tiene gran velocidad. Aunque de primeras parece limpio debajo del sofá había una cantidad de suciedad acumulada considerable, no saben lo que es una limpieza a fondo. Pero todo esto se queda en minucias al lado de nuestra experiencia. La primera noche nada más llegar el detector de humos estaba estropeado, no paraba de pitar y acabamos desconectándolo. Aunque dijeron que vendría un técnico nunca llegó a pasar, estuvimos 3 días diciendo a qué horas podían venir pero el técnico siempre iba con retraso o le surgía alguna urgencia así que al final desistimos y optamos por que lo arreglaran al marcharnos. La segunda mañana nos despertamos porque escuchamos que alguien intentaba entrar, metiendo la llave en la cerradura y golpeando la puerta, estábamos muertas de miedo porque nosotras no habíamos dado permiso para que viniese el técnico en nuestra ausencia ni habíamos concretado ninguna hora. No llegamos a saber nunca quién intentó entrar, si el técnico o alguien de la calle, porque la puerta no tiene mirilla. Al salir nos cruzamos en las escaleras con una mujer que subía, y por su aspecto y comportamiento podemos decir que era una drogadicta.

Spacious and bright apartment in a quiet family neighbourhood, could be improved with a few tweaks. - Very spacious, brightly-lit property in a convenient, quiet neighborhood with good local food options and access to Metro, RER, parks. Air conditioning and hot water both excellent. Easy to follow instructions to access the property. The kitchen could have been better equipped (e.g. with a cutting board). The bathroom, although spacious, had a lot of peeling paint (would benefit from a stronger fan). The coffee table had come unscrewed and was a bit wobbly. Also, as the main bedroom faces onto a street at raised ground floor level, it would have been great to have a privacy curtain or privacy film on the windows so we didn't have to choose between black out curtain or full exposure to passers-by. I think with a few improvements this could be greatly improved.

lastNeg.txt: 50/50 - Отличное местоположение: тихо, безопасно, 2 линии метро рядом, много кафе, ресторанов, продуктовых магазинов, пекарни, пиццерии в шаговой доступности! Чистое постельное бельё, чистые полотенца. Много посуды, есть вся необходимая кухонная техника, медиа техника, розетки, всё супер. Инструкция по заселению очень подробная и простая к пониманию. Замок входной двери болтается, в кухонной зоне недобросовестно убрано: рабочая стенка грязная, губка для посуды умерла в прошлом году, кухонных полотенец нет, посуда очень грязная, дополнительных мешков для мусора нет, веника нет. Жалюзи сломаны, с открытием окон проблемы, к тому же очень грязные. В жаркую погоду лучше не селиться, кондиционера нет. В ванной: крючков нет, умывальники грязные,.
